description.text: SQPsychLLM-8b-gemma-no_questionnaire is a chat model fine-tuned to roleplay a therapist in synthetic, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)-informed counseling conversations. It is part of the SQPsychLLM family released with the paper Roleplaying with Structure: Synthetic Therapist-Client Conversation Generation from Questionnaires. This checkpoint is Llama-3-8B-Instruct supervised-fine-tuned on SQPsychConv (Gemma, no-questionnaire ablation), the synthetic corpus generated by google/gemma-3-27b-it from real, de-identified structured client profiles. This is the no-questionnaire ablation: unlike the main models, the client agent was not conditioned on questionnaire scores (BDI, HAM-D) during data generation.

serving.text_only_input_quote: messages = [{"role": "system", "content": "You are an empathetic therapist conducting a CBT-informed session."}, {"role": "user", "content": "I've felt down and unmotivated for weeks and I don't know why."}]
serving.system_prompt: You are an empathetic therapist conducting a CBT-informed session.
serving.notes: No tokenizer, tokenizer_config.json, or chat_template.jinja is in the repository. The card example uses temperature 0.7, do_sample true, and max_new_tokens 512. finetune.py sets learning_rate 2e-5, per_device_train_batch_size 2, and gradient_accumulation_steps 16. The paper says the SQPsychLLM fine-tunes use 5 epochs and learning rate 2e-4.

evaluation_reported.text: The paper's ablation table, labeled SQPsychLLM gemma under finetuning on client metadata only, reports CounselingBench zero-shot recall 0.52 and F1 0.52, zero-shot chain-of-thought recall 0.58 and score 0.58, and CBT-Bench CBT-CD recall 0.49 / F1 0.32, CBT-PC recall 0.80 / F1 0.69, CBT-FC recall 0.57 / F1 0.35. The paper does not print this repository id.
